[EN] Oh, we've much to learn from the argons. Understanding their metallurgy helps us find weaknesses to exploit. Look around—do you honestly think they didn't study us before they invaded?
[ES] Oh, tenemos mucho que aprender de los argons. Comprender su metalurgia nos ayuda a encontrar debilidades que explotar. Mira a tu alrededor, ¿de verdad crees que no nos estudiaron antes de invadir?
